hero.subtitle: NIYO IREME UNIT COMPANY LTD is a Rwandan company delivering construction, finishing, painting, cleaning, supervision, equipment and workforce services.

story.title: Raising the standard of building work in Rwanda
story.body1: NIYO IREME UNIT COMPANY LTD was founded in Kigali to give Rwandan homeowners and contractors a dependable option for finishing and construction work: skilled labour, good materials, clear prices and work that is supervised rather than left to chance.
story.body2: We work on residential and commercial sites across Kigali and elsewhere in Rwanda. Whether it is a gypsum ceiling, a fresh coat of paint, a tiled terrace or a crew of workers for your site, the approach is the same — agree the scope, use good materials, supervise the work and hand over something we are proud of.
story.body3: NIYO IREME UNIT COMPANY LTD provides professional construction, house finishing, decoration and painting services in Kigali, Rwanda. Our services include construction and renovation, ceilings, tiling, wallpaper, terrazzo, glass, plastering, cleaning, project supervision and the sale of building materials. We also use and rent available modern construction equipment, and we connect skilled workers with employers according to their needs. We are committed to quality workmanship, professional service, quality materials and customer satisfaction.

items.title: Ubwiza (Beauty)
items.body: Careful, clean finishes and decorations that make a home feel considered rather than merely completed.

items.title: Ubunyamwuga (Professionalism)
items.body: Clear written scope, agreed prices, respectful timelines and a professional site presence from start to finish.

items.title: Ireme (Quality)
items.body: Reliable materials and workmanship that stands up to Rwanda's climate and to daily use.

items.title: Ubufatanye (Partnership)

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: Straight answers about our services in Kigali, our materials, our prices and how to get started.

faq.emptyBody: Try a different search term, or contact us directly.

faq-1.question: How do I request a site visit and a quotation?
faq-1.answer: Use the Request a Quotation page on this website, send us a message from the Contact page, or call or WhatsApp us on +250 781 294 928. We visit sites in Kigali and elsewhere in Rwanda, measure the work, and reply with a written, itemised quotation.

faq-2.question: What does your house finishing and decoration service cover?
faq-2.answer: We supervise your project from start to finish and provide modern interior and exterior decoration. We also advise you on the colours that suit your home. Specific finishes such as ceilings, tiles or painting are quoted according to what your site needs.

faq-3.question: Do you sell paint and painting materials as well as painting services?
faq-3.answer: Yes. We provide professional painting services, create different decorative finishes on walls, and supply paint and painting materials at competitive prices. We also advise customers on suitable colours and painting materials for their walls.

faq-4.question: Which construction work do you take on?
faq-4.answer: We handle house construction and renovation, terrace construction, ceiling installation and finishing, tile installation, Slings and other related construction work, and glass installation.

faq-5.question: How does your worker recruitment and employer matching work?
faq-5.answer: We help employers find skilled and experienced workers, and we connect workers and employers according to the needs of both sides. Tell us how many workers you need, which trade, and for how long, and we will propose suitable people.

faq-6.question: What does the company slogan mean?
faq-6.answer: "Kunoza umurimo ni inshingano zacu!" means doing every job well is our responsibility. It is the standard we apply to every job, whether it is a single room or a full build.

faq-7.question: Do you offer cleaning services?
faq-7.answer: Yes. We clean homes, offices and other agreed spaces, including post-renovation clean-up where it is part of the agreed scope. Tell us the size of the space and what needs cleaning.

faq-8.question: Can I rent construction equipment from you?
faq-8.answer: We use modern construction equipment on our projects and rent available equipment. Availability changes, so contact us with the equipment, dates and site location; we will confirm specifications and rental arrangements.

faq-9.question: Do you sell building materials?
faq-9.answer: Yes. We sell available building materials and finishing supplies. Contact us for current availability and prices; we do not publish a fixed price list because stock changes.

faq.ctaBody: Call us or send a message and we will answer directly.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.subtitle: What this website collects, why, and what we do with it.

intro.title: About this policy
intro.body: NIYO IREME UNIT COMPANY LTD is based in Kimironko, Kigali, Rwanda. This policy explains how the information you give us through this website is collected and used.

collected.title: Information we collect
collected.body: When you submit a quotation request or a contact message we collect the details you type in — typically your name, email address, telephone number, project location, the service you are interested in and the description you write. We do not collect payment card details and we do not use cookies to track you across other websites.

emailjs.title: Email delivery
emailjs.body: Messages submitted through this website are delivered to our inbox using the EmailJS service. EmailJS acts as the transport for the form: it receives what you submit and forwards it to us. Please do not include sensitive personal or financial information in the free-text fields.

maps.title: Maps and external links
maps.body: The map on our contact page is served by OpenStreetMap, and the map buttons open Google Maps. When you follow those links, the map provider's own privacy policy applies. We do not embed advertising or analytics trackers on this website.

retention.title: How long we keep your details
retention.body: We keep enquiry details only as long as they are needed to answer your request and to follow up on a project. We do not sell or rent your information to third parties.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask us at any time what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Contact us by phone on +250 781 294 928 or via the contact page.

children.title: Children
children.body: This website is a business website and is not intended for children. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy as the website changes. The date at the top of this page always shows the most recent version.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about this policy can be sent to NIYO IREME UNIT COMPANY LTD, Kimironko, Kigali, Rwanda, or by telephone on +250 781 294 928.

ariceKicukiro.quote: They repaired the walls, applied plaster and wall master, then finished with silk and weatherguard paint. The rooms look clean and the finish is holding up well.

joselineRusororo.project: Ceiling, plaster & interior and exterior painting
joselineRusororo.quote: The team installed the ceiling, plastered the house and painted both the inside and outside. They protected the furniture and left the site tidy.

jackMurugando.quote: My house had badly finished walls and cracks. They corrected the plaster, applied wall master and epoxy, and the surface now looks properly finished.

ingabireNoroveje.quote: They plastered the whole house, applied wall master inside and out, and finished with a clean coat of paint. The work was organised and the result is beautiful.

kalekezBumbogo.quote: They fitted the gypsum ceiling, plastered the walls and completed the decoration with matt and silk finishes. The house feels completely transformed.
